Direct Connection Netrunning

A Netrunner may use Interface Plugs to establish a direct connection to a target's Neuroport.

Awake targets automatically become aware of the intrusion.

While directly connected:

  • Gain +1 NET Action.
  • Ignore Passwalls.
  • Black ICE remains active.

If either participant moves more than one square apart, the connection is broken and the Netrunner is Unsafely Jacked Out.
